translations.web: The testimony is this, that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
translations.bsb: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
translations.kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
translations.asv: And the witness is this, that God gave unto us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
